items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: let's see, who did we have, Harry Carney... The band was under my name... And then another time we'd rotated and the band was under Harry Carney's name.

ctx.x: Harry Carney. This is -- we're going back east, now. I'm trying to remember who the eastern (Unintelligible). And then most of -- a lot of the guys who were here had moved out here, still from back there.
